verdict.rationale: Canny documents a staging/sandbox workspace that is a completely separate instance of Canny, so testing is isolated from production data (true sandbox isolation, not a dry-run). However, it is limited to the Business plan, must be set up by contacting support, and is a general workspace rather than an API test mode or test keys, with no mention in the developer docs. Missing for 10: self-serve or programmatic sandbox provisioning, API-level test mode or test keys, availability beyond the Business plan, developer-docs coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: For accounts on the Business plan, we offer a free workspace for staging/sandbox purposes
Each workspace is a completely separate instance of Canny
